title: Water Shortage Crisis in Gokuldham
description: Gokuldham Society faces a major water pipeline breakdown, leading to morning chaos among Jethalal, Bhide, Sodhi, and Popatlal.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL Season 1)
tagline: Jetha Ke Janbaaz vs Daya Ke Daredevils
description: The inaugural cricket tournament in Gokuldham Society pitting Jethalal's team against Daya's team.

title: The Famous Bhootni Arc in Gokuldham
description: A mysterious ghost in a white saree haunts Gokuldham Society, scaring Mohanlal, Jethalal, and Bhide.

title: Champaklal's Unstoppable Hiccups
description: Bapuji suffers from non-stop hiccups that won't go away, prompting the entire Gokuldham society to try hilarious remedies.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL Season 2)
tagline: Jabardast Jetha vs Daya Ke Daredevils
description: The grand second season of GPL with special celebrity guests and intense cricket drama.

title: Gulabo Marriage Lawsuit in Kutch
description: A woman named Gulabo arrives in Gokuldham claiming she is Jethalal's lawfully wedded wife from a film shoot in Kutch.

title: Jethalal Trapped in Pakistan Border
description: Jethalal accidentally crosses the Rann of Kutch border into Pakistan on a camel, leading to a high-stakes rescue mission.

title: Gokuldham Premier League (GPL Season 3)
description: The third edition of Gokuldham Premier League featuring professional stadium production and thrilling matches.

title: Popatlal & Bulbul Marriage Arc
description: Popatlal gets ready to marry Bulbul, but discovers a secret about her lover Rahul, leading to a heartwarming sacrifice.

title: Khushi Baby Adoption Arc
description: An abandoned baby girl named Khushi is found by Gokuldham residents, bringing immense joy and emotional bonding to the society.

title: Jethalal In London Adventure
description: Jethalal wins a trip to London, England, leading to hilarious culture shocks, sightseeing, and lost passports.

title: Gokuldham Society Renovation Arc
tagline: New Paint, Modern Look & Furniture Drama
description: Gokuldham Society undergoes complete architectural renovation and repainting, sparking disputes among members.

title: Mission KALA KAUWA (COVID Vaccine Sting)
description: Popatlal and Dr. Hathi perform a dangerous undercover sting operation at a luxury resort to expose black-marketeers.

title: Spider-Man In Gokuldham (18th Anniversary)
description: Spider-Man visits Gokuldham Society to celebrate 18 glorious years of Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah with all residents.
